amendments_recorded: Start with Code + History layers only (Knowledge/Decision/Incident/Procedural/Agent-state deferred).
Stable canonical entity IDs; revision and content hashes are separate properties, never part of identity.
Inferred relationships are explicitly marked (provenance + source + confidence).

scope.deferred_note: Ticket/Incident/Fix nodes and AFFECTS/RESOLVED_BY edges belong to the incident-memory lifecycle (Workstream B ownership). Adding them requires the shared-contract change procedure.

identity.rule: revision and content_hash are node properties only. Re-ingesting a new revision must not mint a new entity_id for an unchanged logical entity.

Test.note: A Test is a Function subclass by detection convention; it is a distinct kind for query filtering.

CONTAINS.note: to is positional with from: File->(Module|Class|Function|Test), Module->(Class|Function), Class->(Class|Function).

IMPORTS.note: Only in-repo resolvable imports become edges. External or unresolvable imports are recorded solely in the importing File's imports_declared property; no edge is fabricated for them.

provenance_policy.observed_when: call target uniquely resolves within the repository via same-module scope or resolved imports
provenance_policy.inferred_when: target resolved by name-only heuristic (multiple candidates or dynamic attribute call)

provenance_policy.observed_when: produced from an actual coverage run artifact (source coverage-run)
git log / diff hunk intersects the entity span at the pre-image revision (Function) or touches the path (File)
CODEOWNERS (or equivalent) matches the path (source codeowners)
provenance_policy.inferred_when: derived from historical authorship share (source git-history-ownership-heuristic)

definitions.observed: relationship read directly from an authoritative artifact: source AST structure, git object, CODEOWNERS entry, or coverage run output.
definitions.inferred: relationship produced by a heuristic: name-based call resolution, test-name convention, or authorship-share ownership. Must carry source and confidence.

provenance.rule: Every edge MUST declare provenance and source. Inferred edges MUST declare confidence. Retrieval and manifests must never present inferred edges as observed.

common_node_properties.revision: full git SHA of the snapshot this node was extracted from
common_node_properties.content_hash: optional; hash of the exact source text for code nodes

common_edge_properties.revision: full git SHA of the snapshot
common_edge_properties.commit_sha: optional; the commit that introduced the relationship for code-derived edges
common_edge_properties.valid_from: optional ISO-8601; defaults to commit time of commit_sha
common_edge_properties.valid_to: optional ISO-8601; null while valid; set (not deleted) when invalidated by a later revision

temporal.invalidation: When a file changes at a new revision, affected nodes/edges are re-ingested and superseded edges receive valid_to instead of being deleted, preserving replay of history.

tenancy.model: one FalkorDB graph per tenant or team
tenancy.rule: graph selection happens at the client level; the query layer must refuse cross-graph queries.

constraints: Edges connect only kinds permitted by the edge definition.
No edges reference node types from deferred layers.
revision values are full 40-character git SHAs.
The schema does not claim complete call/dependency/test coverage; parser limitations are documented in docs/graph/.
